rule CobaltStrike_Beacon_HTTP_Profile {
    meta:
        description = "Detects HTTP traffic patterns consistent with Cobalt Strike beacons"
        author = "SOC Team"
        reference = "https://attack.mitre.org/software/S0154/"
        date = "2026-04-11"
    strings:
        $http_get = /GET \/[a-z]{4}\/[a-z]{8} HTTP\/1\.1/ ascii
        $http_post = /POST \/[a-z]{4} HTTP\/1\.1/ ascii
        $header_host = "Host:" ascii
        $header_useragent = "User-Agent: Mozilla/5.0" ascii
        $header_accept = "Accept: */*" ascii
    condition:
        $http_get and $http_post and $header_host and $header_useragent and $header_accept
}

description: Detects multiple scan attempts from known Tor exit nodes to the same internal host within a short time window.
status: experimental
author: SOC Team

  product: generic

      - '185.220.101.118'

  scan_activity:
    dst_ip: 10.0.0.0/16
    event_type: port_scan
  condition: tor_exit and scan_activity
  timeframe: 5m
level: high

arguments.summary: A distributed port scan was detected from 10 Tor exit nodes targeting internal network 10.0.0.0/16. The scan was identified as coordinated reconnaissance activity. All source IPs were previously observed in low-severity scan alerts on 2026-04-08, indicating persistent probing. No evidence of exploitation or malware execution was found. Containment actions included blocking all malicious IPs at the firewall. The targeted asset (WS-IT-101) was scanned and confirmed clean.

timeline.description: Initial low-severity scan alerts from multiple Tor exit nodes targeting WS-IT-101 (10.0.2.15) detected by IDS.
Distributed scan alert triggered due to coordinated activity from 10 Tor exit nodes. Incident initiated.
IOC lookups performed on source IPs; all linked to prior scan events and confirmed as Tor exit nodes.
SIEM correlation confirmed repeated scanning activity from same IPs over past 7 days. No successful intrusions detected.
Sandbox analysis of associated payloads returned 'clean' verdict with low risk score.
Containment: All 10 source IPs blocked at perimeter firewall.
Eradication: Full vulnerability and malware scan of WS-IT-101 completed with no anomalies found.
Incident response concluded. Post-incident review initiated.
